ev.tests.first_ok: {r_role}'s new tests all fail on the request commit; development starts
ev.tests.rerun: Independent rerun: release.sh {verdict}[[differs|; checks that differ from the last round: {differs}]]
ev.bench.go: All checks passed and review cleared it: to the bench (time {n}), doctor.sh first
ev.bench.deploy: Bench ready, deploying {artifact}: waiting for a person to approve this build on the console
ev.bench.replay: Deployed; replaying the recorded drive data: waiting for a person's approval on the console
ev.bench.replayed: Replay done; running the post-bench checks ({run_dir})
ev.bench.rerun: Post-bench checks all passed: rerunning every check from scratch in a new results folder, then release.sh
ev.hold.restart: The bench's "{step}" was not finished when the app restarted: check the action log and the target state on the console, then retry
ev.hold.no_artifact: No build to deploy: {artifact} (the output of build.sh)
ev.hold.after_bench: Post-bench checks need a person's decision: {why}
ev.hold.release: release.sh did not pass on the independent rerun: {why}
ev.gate.overrule: Waiting for a decision on {g_gate}: [[rounds|review still asks for changes after {rounds} rounds|review asks for changes]]; send it back once more, or overrule the review with a written reason
ev.talk.gate: The person discusses with {r_role} at the {g_gate} gate: {note}
ev.approved.overrule: The person overruled the review and approved {g_gate}: {note}
ev.plan.split: {r_role} proposes the division: {plan}[[skip|; not this time: {skip}]]
ev.plan.no_split: {r_role} proposed no division ({file}); dispatching per the team file
ev.plan.no_delivery: {r_role} proposed no delivery labels ({file}); per the team file: {delivery}
ev.plan.delivery_confirmed: The person confirmed the delivery labels: {delivery}
ev.plan.questions: {r_role} lists {n} things for a person to decide
ev.plan.triage: {r_role}'s triage: {n} for a person to decide, {listed} done as triaged (see the triage document)
ev.plan.triage_base: Triage base set to the run branch at kickoff, {base}: every commit from now on names its findings
ev.again.transient: the model backend failed; continuing in a new session
ev.held.owner: failed, and the role that owns it can no longer change it
ev.triage.q.justify: {id}: triage proposes to explain it as a false positive or harmless, not fix it[[label| (the backlog says {label})]]: {where}
ev.triage.q.defer: {id}: triage proposes to defer it[[label| (the backlog says {label})]]: {where}
ev.triage.q.differs: {id}: the decision differs from the backlog (the backlog says {label}): {decision}, {where}
ev.triage.opt.add: Agree to add it to this batch
ev.triage.opt.no_add: Disagree: do not add it (send back to triage)
ev.triage.opt.justify: Agree to explain it (the review still checks the citations)
ev.triage.opt.fix: Disagree: fix it in this batch (send back to triage for evidence and behaviour)
ev.sign.not_ended: A run can be signed off only after it ends
ev.sign.release: release.sh did not pass on the independent rerun, so it cannot be signed off: {why}
ev.sign.failed: The run failed and delivered nothing, so it cannot be signed off (you can retry the failed roles)
ev.sign.stopped: The run was stopped and delivered nothing, so it cannot be signed off
ev.sign.no_rerun: There is no independent rerun and release.sh result yet, so it cannot be signed off
AppBar.present.hint: For a recording: people shown as their role (Release owner); this Mac's home folder is always shown as ~. Display only; nothing recorded changes
common.viaKiro: (asked Kiro to click it in a Kiro session)
board.Header.replayLead: What this gate asked the person, as asked; each item's recommendation is marked. The replay answers nothing: what the person decided is in the feed.
